Kovalenko wrote: TTN

BTW - we had also a signal to long

Hi Alex, hope you are doing well!

I couldn't help but revisit this old trade you took. Whether price breaking a FL or FTR results in an engulf vs. a fakeout can be difficult to determine. I've seen advanced traders here on RTM who sometimes get it wrong. Do you purposefully wait for a possible engulf to occur, and watch to see how price interacts with the origin of that possible engulf? If price also breaks the DP/source FL of the original engulf, can you be more sure that the initial move you originally assumed was an engulf, is instead a fakeout?

Adopting this strategy would mean many traders end up missing out on the opportunity to successfully trade the original 'possible' engulf, however I wonder if being patient and waiting for this confirmation drastically increases the odds of a profitable trade...not to mention it forms a basic QM.

Sorry if this post is confusing..it can be hard to put these ideas in to words... here is a drawing to illustrate my question:

I think that a very important point is to learn to read PA in the important areas. For example here I would be looking for a long entry at FTB to the "more important FL".
